import os
import tempfile
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
p = d + "/data"
row = 0
for encoding in ["utf-8", "latin-1"]:
    for nl in ["", "\n", "\r", "\r\n"]:
        for text in ["", "ASCII", "é", "Grüße\n", "a\nb\r\nc", "\x00é", "".join([chr(233), chr(255)])]:
            with open(p, "w", encoding=encoding, newline=nl) as f:
                w = f.write
                a = f.write(text)
                f.write(str(w(text)))
                b = w(text)
                cs: list[int] = [w(text), f.write(text)]
                f.writelines([text, text])
                print(text, file=f, end="")
            with open(p, "a", encoding=encoding, newline=nl) as f:
                c = f.write(text)
            with open(p, encoding="latin-1", newline="") as f:
                raw = f.read()
            print(row, a, b, cs, c, [ord(x) for x in raw])
            row += 1
with open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    text = "".join([chr(0x1F600), chr(0x65E5), chr(0x672C), chr(0x8A9E), chr(0x301)])
    print("wide", f.write(text), len(text), f.write(text[1:]))
os.remove(p)
os.rmdir(d)

        err = (ROOT/f).with_suffix('.err')

        stderr_last = p.stderr.splitlines()[-1]+'\n' if p.stderr else ''
        ok = p.stdout+f'[exit {p.returncode}]\n' == (ROOT/f).with_suffix('.out').read_text() and stderr_last == expected_err
        results[f] = dict(exit=p.returncode, stdout=p.stdout, stderr_last=stderr_last, stderr_sha256=hashlib.sha256(p.stderr.encode()).hexdigest(), recording_equal=ok)
